scenes.text: A salvage crew found a derelict ship, still broadcasting.
scenes.art_prompt: the countdown that repeats - scene 1, cinematic, retro-sci

scenes.text: One number, counting down. It had been counting for four hundred years.
scenes.art_prompt: the countdown that repeats - scene 2, cinematic, retro-sci

scenes.text: They waited for zero. They braced for a blast that never came.
scenes.art_prompt: the countdown that repeats - scene 3, cinematic, retro-sci

scenes.text: At zero, the number reset. It began again from the top, without a pause.
scenes.art_prompt: the countdown that repeats - scene 4, cinematic, retro-sci

scenes.text:
It was never a countdown.
It is a reply - sent once per orbit, to a question we stopped asking.
scenes.art_prompt: the countdown that repeats - scene 5, cinematic, retro-sci

scenes.text: Follow Deep Space Logs for the next entry.
